units.text: INT. FISH AUCTION HALL - 4 A.M.
A cavernous concrete shed, wet floor, floodlights humming over rows of ice-packed crates.
The air smells of brine and diesel.
A digital auction board above the pit blinks red numbers that nobody is watching.
ANSELM KRAUSE (50s, heavy-set, oilskin coat, a gold tooth catching the light) sits on an overturned crate at the center.
He turns a fish scale in his fingers.
Across from him stands CORRIGAN BLACK (40s, narrow, long camel coat out of place among rubber boots).
He holds a leather briefcase against his chest.
Behind Corrigan, DESSA OYELARAN (30s, sharp bob, auctioneer's clipboard) watches the doors.
Next to her, BAO TRAN (20s, forklift driver, earbuds dangling) fidgets with a pallet jack.
EVERETT SLOANE (60s, ex-harbor police, grey stubble, cheap suit) leans against a pillar with a cigarette he has not lit.
FITZ MORROW (20s, tackle-shop clerk, sweating through a windbreaker) crouches by the loading door.
You are four minutes late.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: The tide table lied.
units.name: CORRIGAN

units.text: Tide tables don't lie. Men do.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Corrigan sets the briefcase on the crate.
Doesn't open it.
It's all there.
units.name: CORRIGAN

units.text: I'll count it.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Count it faster.
units.name: EVERETT

units.text: Dessa shifts her weight.
Her eyes stay on the doors.
Truck's idling on the east dock. If it moves, I move.
units.name: DESSA

units.text: Is this still the tuna thing?
units.name: BAO

units.text: Put your earbud back in, Bao.
units.name: DESSA

units.text: Bao obeys, too quickly.
Anselm snaps the clasps.
Counts.
His lips move.
Corrigan watches Anselm's hands, not the money.
It's the full amount.
units.name: CORRIGAN

units.text: It's a full amount.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Fitz stands.
The knees of his jeans are wet.
We should go. Both of you. Now.
units.name: FITZ

units.text: Sit down, Fitz.
units.name: EVERETT

units.text: Everett, the boats are coming back in. I can hear the winches.
units.name: FITZ

units.text: Everett finally lights the cigarette.
Then we have until the first crate hits the ice.
units.name: EVERETT

units.text: Anselm closes the briefcase.
Slides it under the crate with his boot.
He doesn't trust you.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Which "he"?
units.name: CORRIGAN

units.text: Pick one.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Corrigan glances at Everett.
At Fitz.
Nobody blinks.
Somewhere in the dark, a winch screams.
A crate crashes onto the concrete.
Water sloshes across the floor toward the five pairs of boots and one pair of leather shoes.
Nobody moves.
